end.summary:
Observed links between bird beak/foot shapes and feeding or movement.
Discussed kingfisher, sparrow, eagle, duck, hen, and woodpecker examples.
Connected broad feet to spreading weight on snow or mud and webbed feet to pushing water.
Linked plant features such as thorns and thin leaves with reducing water loss.
Teach-back was not passed; no specific misconception was recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised observing beaks, feet, leaves, and plant features with Atharv. They explained several useful links, such as webbed feet helping a duck push water and broad feet spreading weight on snow or mud. No specific mix-up was recorded or corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Atharv to choose one local bird or plant and explain how one feature helps it live or move.
